disclaimer: No production DB was available in this environment. Corpus is a representative 10k-repo GithubArchiver-shaped sample (curated gold + realistic noise). Quality conclusions use MiniLM, not hashing-v1.

indexing.timing_note: index_batch_wall_s is end-to-end HTTP indexBatch (serialize+embed+upsert+response). worker_embed_s / worker_upsert_s come from Python worker instrumentation. sync_wall_s is durable sync() only. No synthetic upsert fraction is invented.

memory.note: Python worker RSS includes recursive child processes when visible via ps. Railway sizing uses python_worker_peak_rss_mb, not Node harness RSS.

mode_latency.note: Each mode measured independently. Warm stats exclude the cold first query. Combined 3-mode durations are never labeled as hybrid latency.

recommendation.default_weights_note: Do not change defaults from this synthetic run alone. Current 0.55/0.35/0.10 remains recommended unless production-snapshot traffic clearly prefers another mix.
recommendation.vector_bits_note: 2-bit remains sensible (smallest index, labeled R@10 near exact). Re-check on a production snapshot before raising bits.

railway.suggested_resources: Private MiniLM worker: start with 4 GB RAM / 1 vCPU for this measured peak (948 MB) with headroom. Scale disk/CPU with archive size. Keep indexBatch/remove/rebuild private.
railway.startup: MiniLM load typically a few seconds once weights are cached
